overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the notices were sufficiently specific on their face, and a quorum of the Assembly was not present at the March 25 Finance Committee meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaints alleged that notices for Standing Committee on Finance meetings on March 25, April 1, and April 8 were not specific enough about topics.
allegations.key_passage: Because each of these meetings had not yet occurred when Mr. Beaty filed the corresponding complaint, we find no violation of the Law.

allegations.summary: Complaints alleged that notices for the full Assembly's April 1 and April 15 meetings were not specific enough about topics to be discussed or voted on.
allegations.key_passage: Because each of these meetings had not yet occurred when Mr. Beaty filed the corresponding complaint, we find no violation of the Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged a majority of Assembly members attended the March 25 Finance Committee meeting, so a full Assembly meeting required notice that was not posted.
allegations.key_passage: Because here there were only seven members of the Assembly present, we find that the Assembly was not required to post notice for an Assembly meeting.
